rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MEOK CRA Classifier helps organizations comply with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation 2024/2847) by classifying products with digital elements into CRA hierarchy categories (Default, Class I, Class II, Annex IV), auditing against 15 essential security requirements, generating technical documentation templates per Annex VIII, and producing HMAC-SHA256 signed compliance certificates. Distributed via PyPI.
